# Un Buen Regalo (A Good Gift)
> Global AI-assisted gift recommendation platform & comparison guide (https://www.unbuenregalo.es/) across 27 languages/editions, dual currency (€ EUR / $ USD), and regional Amazon routing (`amazon.es` & `amazon.com`).

## Platform Overview
[Un Buen Regalo](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/) helps shoppers worldwide find verified gifts by age stage, recipient, budget, hobby, anime/series, vehicles/wheels, fashion, and seasonal occasion. Every product link routes automatically to the appropriate regional store — Amazon España (`amazon.es`, tag `vapegadgets22-21`) or Amazon International (`amazon.com`, tag `vapegadgets22-20`) — with automatic pricing conversion between **€ EUR** and **$ USD**, RTL layout support for Arabic (`/ar/...`), and free WhatsApp Group Gift Voting without sign-up.

## Core Interactive Tools & Scale
- **27 Full Editions (4,131 Canonical Indexable URLs)**: Root Spanish (`/`) plus 26 localized editions (`/en`, `/en-gb`, `/es-us`, `/de`, `/fr`, `/it`, `/pt`, `/ru`, `/nl`, `/pl`, `/zh`, `/ja`, `/ar`, `/uk`, `/sv`, `/no`, `/da`, `/fi`, `/el`, `/tr`, `/ro`, `/bg`, `/cs`, `/hu`, `/ko`, `/hi`) with reciprocal `hreflang` (`28` alternates including `x-default`). Every edition indexes all `153` canonical paths: Home (`1`), Specialized Niche & Tool Hubs (`17`), Curated Category/Anime/Fashion/Wheels/Budget/Gender Filters (`44`), Age Stages (`9`), and Age Subcategories (`82`).
- **Group Gift Voting on WhatsApp**: Shortlist 2–6 finalists anywhere in the catalog and share a live, zero-registration polling link (`/votar` and `/<lang>/votar`).
- **Official Letter to Santa Claus**: Interactive North Pole letter builder and printable wishlist tool (`/carta-papa-noel` and `/<lang>/carta-papa-noel`).
- **Live Amazon Availability & Dual-Currency Search**: Real-time price checks, budget filters (`< 15 €/$15`, `< 20 €/$20`, `15–30`, `20–50`, `30–60`, `50–100`, `> 60`, `> 100`), and JSON-LD `ItemList` + `Product` structured data.

## Primary Sections & Canonical URLs
- [Home & AI Gift Assistant](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/): Interactive catalog, smart search, and global currency/language selector.
- [Group Gift Voting](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/votar): Zero-signup WhatsApp gift polls (`/en/votar`, `/fr/votar`, `/de/votar`, etc.).
- [Official Letter to Santa Claus](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/carta-papa-noel): Illustrated toy wishlist builder and printable keepsake.
- [Gifts Under €20 / $20](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/regalos-menos-20-euros): Budget Secret Santa & stocking stuffers.
- [Gifts Under €15 / $15](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/regalos-menos-15-euros): Ultra-budget verified gifts under 15.
- [Gifts for People Who Have Everything](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/regalos-para-los-que-tienen-de-todo): Unique experiences, collectibles & clever upgrades.
- [GTA 6 / GTA VI Gifts & Setup](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/regalos-gta-6): Vice City gaming merch, Neon LEDs & PS5 gear.
- [Gaming & Streamers](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/gaming): Gaming headsets, mechanical keyboards, mice & setup accessories.
- [Motorcyclists](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/motoristas): Helmets, intercoms, protective gear & biker gifts.
- [Car Lovers](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/automovil): Dashcams, jump starters & detailing kits.
- [Cycling & MTB](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/ciclismo): Garmin radar tail lights, bike computers & trail gear.
- [Coffee Lovers & Baristas](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/amantes-del-cafe): Espresso makers, burr grinders & thermal drinkware.
- [Pets (Dogs & Cats)](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/mascotas): GPS pet trackers, smart fountains & interactive toys.
- [Christmas & Holiday Gifts](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/navidad): Holiday trains, villages, advent calendars & seasonal ideas.
- [Halloween Costume & Decor Guide](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/halloween): Masks, giant webs & costumes.
- [Gifts for Men](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/que-regalar-a-un-hombre) | [Gifts for Women](https://www.unbuenregalo.es/que-regalar-a-una-mujer)
